meta.titulo: Latin American currencies today: dollar, bolívar, peso, real and more — {marca}
meta.descripcion: What a dollar is worth today in bolívars, Mexican pesos, reais, soles, Colombian, Chilean, Argentine and Dominican pesos, guaraníes and euros, according to each central bank.

monedas.entrada: What one US dollar is worth in each currency, according to its central bank.
monedas.vieja: The latest figure is from {fecha}; it isn't published because it's outdated.
monedas.nota: Official rates from each central bank (BCV, Banxico, Banco Central do Brasil, Superfinanciera, BCRA, SUNAT, Banco Central de Chile, Banco Central del Paraguay and the ECB). Where a bank publishes no API, the figure comes from open.er-api.com. The Cayman Islands dollar is pegged.
monedas.aviso: These are official closes and reference rates, not live quotes. To trade, check with your bank.

grafica.lectura: Going up means it takes more of the currency to buy one dollar: the currency is weakening. This is not inflation, though the two often move together.
